<entry id="H00531">
<head-word>חִזָּיוֹן, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced. wds.) 
<italic>vision</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. חֶזְיוֹנוֹת</plural-form> (fem.). Snh. 39
<sup>b</sup> (play on והזנות, I Kings XXII, 38) כדי למרק שתי ח' Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) in order to polish (make clear) two visions. Ib. (play on לתמו, ib. 34) כדי לתמם שתי ח' to fulfill two visions. Gen. R. s. 13; Yalk. ib. 20 (ref. to חָזִיז, q. v.) שעושה ח' ברקיע וכ' He creates (awe-inspiring) sights in the sky and causes holy inspiration to rest &c. [Ar. s. v. אד: חֲזִיזִיּוֹת, fr. חֲזיזִית, 
<italic>breaks, splits</italic>.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00532">
<head-word>חִזָּיוֹן, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> or חֶזְיוֹנָה (v. 
<xref rid="H00522">חֲזָזִית</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>lichen, moss</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 105
<sup>b</sup> ramification (סוכה) is considered weak, שנחבאת בחֶזְיוֹנָהּ (or בחזיונָה) when it is hidden under (fully covered with) moss. [Ar. ed. בחיזונה, ed. Koh. בחזיונה; comment.: 
<italic>the grip of the hand</italic>, fr. אחז; marg. emend.: באֲחַזְיוֹנָה, v. Tosaf. a. l.]—Erub. 28
<sup>a</sup> אבל לא בחזין ולא בחזניות Ms. M. (Rabb. D. S. a. l. note quotes חזיונות) but neither with lichens nor with lichen dishes (Lecanora esculenta).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> pl. חֶזְיוֹנוֹת 
<italic>lichen, scab;</italic> trnsf. 
<italic>irregular lumps</italic> of clouds.</definition>
<notes> Y. Taan. III, 66
<sup>c</sup> bot. a cloud is called 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>aziz</italic> (v. next w.) שהוא עושה … ח' ח' וכ' for He makes the sky full of irregular lumps (cumuli), as we read (Zech. X, 1), the Lord makes  
<italic>ḥăzizim</italic></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00533">
<head-word>חָזִיז, </head-word>
<head-word>חֲזִיז</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="H00522">חֲזָזִית</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>cloud with uneven surface</italic> (like scabs or swollen lumps), 
<italic>cumulus</italic> (which brings rain).</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 13 (allegorical explanation), v. חִזָּיוֹן I. Y. Taan. III, 66
<sup>c</sup> bot., v. preced.—Bab. ib. 9
<sup>b</sup>.—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲזִיזִים</plural-form>. Ib. מאי ח' what are 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>azizim</italic> (Zech. X, 1)? Answ. פורחות eruptions (defined: ‘a thin under a thick cloud’).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> [Readings vary between חזיז a. חִזִּין, pl. of חֵז] 
<italic>lichen</italic>, used as food (Lecantora esculenta).</definition>
<notes> Erub. 28
<sup>a</sup>, v. חִזָּיוֹן II.—B. Kam. 119
<sup>b</sup> כשות וח' וכ' the law of robbery does not apply to cuscuta and lichen. Keth. 60
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> [Readings vary as ab.] 
<italic>young blades of grain</italic> used for pasture.</definition>
<notes> Taan. 5
<sup>a</sup> אוכל ח' מן התלמים Ms. M. (some ed. הזיז) eats the young green from the furrows. B. Kam. 58
<sup>b</sup> bot. [Tosef. Ohol. XIII, 11 שני חזיזין, read: הזיזין, v. זִיז II.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00541">
<head-word>חֲזִיר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>swine</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. IX, 2 ח' של ישוב domesticated swine; ח' הבר wild boar. Num. R. s. 12 מה איסור … לְהַחֲ' וכ' is the swine more strictly forbidden than other unclean animals?—Lev. R. s. 13 ואת הח' זו פרס 
<pgbrk id="pg444" />(read רומי or אדום). Ib. מה ח' וכ' as the swine … stretches out its cloven feet (sign of cleanness), … so does the Roman government &c., v. בִּימָה. Gen. R. s. 65, beg.; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲזִירִים, חֲזִירִין</plural-form>. Kidd. 49
<sup>b</sup> תשעה נטלו ח' nine (measures of plagues) did swines receive. B. Kam. VII, 7; a. e.—Fem. חֲזִירָה, חֲזִירְתָּה 
<italic>sow</italic>. Esth. R. to III, 1. Ib. to I, 15 לח' כדת וכ' the swine (Vashti) to be treated according to law, but the holy people &c.!, v. אַכְזְרִיּוּת.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00542">

<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>Targ. Ps. LXXX, 14.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Lev. XI, 7 (some ed. חֲזֵי').—Y. Ber. II, 4
<sup>c</sup> bot. אהן ח' וכ' the swine is a moving privy. Sabb. 155
<sup>b</sup> לית … מן ח' none is poorer than the dog, none richer than the swine (finding its food everywhere); a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲזִירִין, חֲזִירֵי</plural-form>. Gen. R. s. 63; Y. Ter. VIII, end, 46
<sup>c</sup>, v. דִּיקְלִטְיָאנוֹס. Taan. 21
<sup>b</sup> איכא מותנא בח' there is an epidemic among the swine; a. e.—Fem. חֲזִירְתָּא, Lam. R. to I, 16, end כהדא ח' וכ' like the (nursing) sow, the more their young fatten &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00545">
<head-word>חֲזִירָה, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (חָזַר) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>return, going back</italic>, opp. הֲלִיכָה.</definition>
<notes> Y. B. Mets. VI, beg. 10
<sup>d</sup> שכר הליכה וח' indemnification for loss of time in going to the field and returning. Lev. R. s. 5 בחֲזִירַת רבותינו לשם when the teachers came again to that place, v. הֲדוּרָה.—Y. Yoma III, 43
<sup>c</sup> bot. דרך ח' on the way homeward. Koh. R. to XI, 9 … מעט בריצה בח' slacken thy speed, that thou mayest not have too far to return (regret and punishment will reach you); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>reconsideration, reversion of judgment</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Hor. I, beg. 45
<sup>d</sup> bot. וכן בח' the same rule applies when the court reverses &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>going round</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sot. I, 16
<sup>c</sup> bot. כדי חֲזִירַת דקל (Bab. ib. 4
<sup>a</sup> חֲזָרַת) the time required for going round a palm-tree.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>restoration</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="H00565">חֲזָרָה</xref>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00547">
<head-word>חָזִית</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (חזז; cmp. גָּזִית fr. גזז) 
<italic>cutting; rough, unfinished side</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tam. II, 4 חֲזִיתָהּ מזרחה the uneven side of the pile (where the thinner and pointed ends of the logs leave gaps and make the front uneven) was eastward. Par. III, 8. Y. Meg. IV, end, 75
<sup>c</sup> bot. נותן בח' he puts (the M’zuzah) on the rough door (which is more used by the inmates); היו שניהן ח' if both are of rough work.—Esp. 
<italic>the rough side of a fence or wall</italic>, indicating that the neighbor had no right to it, 
<italic>border-mark</italic>. B. Bath. I, 2 (2) כונס … ועושה ח' מבחוץ he moves back on his own ground and builds, and makes the border-mark outside. Ib. 4
<sup>a</sup> מאי ח' וכ' wherein consists the border-mark? Answ. He bends the pegs on top outward.—2) 
<italic>rough sore, contusion</italic>.—
<plural-form>Pl. חָזִיּוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>c</sup> bot. (emended in ed. Lehm. כתית, as Sabb. 77
<sup>b</sup>). Cmp. חֲזָזִית.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00549">

<entry id="H00551">
<head-word>חַזָּן</head-word>
<head-word>חָזָן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (חזי) 
<italic>superintendent, officer</italic>; </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (school) 
<italic>governor</italic> superintending children at their studies.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. I, 3 הח' רואה וכ' on Friday night the governor may look in where the children read, but must not read himself.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (in collegiate debates) 
<italic>one who announces the order of proceedings, crier, janitor</italic> &c. Y. Ber. IV, 7
<sup>d</sup> top אמרו לר' זינון הח' וכ' they said to R. Zinon the ḥazan, ‘Say, Commence’ (the debate)!</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (in synagogue) 
<italic>superintendent at prayer-meetings</italic>, giving the signals for responses, assigning seats &c., 
<italic>sexton</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Succ. 51
<sup>b</sup> וח' הכנסת וכ' and the sexton stood upon it with the flag in his hand. Yoma VII, 1; Sot. VII, 8.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (in court) 
<italic>crier, sheriff</italic> (collecting the votes, executing punishment).</definition>
<notes> Macc. III, 12. Y. Sot. VII, 21
<sup>d</sup> top.—
<plural-form>Pl. חַזָּנִים,</plural-form> (חֲזָ') חַזָּנִין. Tam. V, 3 (Temple sextons).—Tosef. Snh. IX, 1 הח' קורין וכ' the criers call out each judge’s name (to take his vote); Y. ib. V, end, 23
<sup>a</sup> חַזָּנֵי כנסיות. Macc. 23
<sup>a</sup> אין מעמידין ח' וכ' we must appoint as constables (for punishing) men of lesser physical strength &c. Sabb. 56
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00552">
<head-word>חַזָּנָא</head-word>
<head-word>חֲזָ'</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>1) same.</definition>
<notes> ch. </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. Y. Ber. V, 9
<sup>c</sup> bot. עאל ח' וכ' the sexton came and urged one to go up (to read the prayers).</definition>
<notes> Y. Meg. IV, 75
<sup>b</sup> bot.; Y. Sot. VII, end, 22
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> חַזַּן מתא 
<italic>town-guard</italic> (watching the flocks of the common and guarding the town by night).</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 93
<sup>b</sup>.—
<plural-form>Pl. חַזָּנֵי מתא</plural-form>. Ib.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H00553">
<head-word>חָזַק</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00437"> cmp. אדק</xref>,
<xref rid="E00144"> הדק</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> חדק)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to squeeze together</italic>,] (neut. verb) 
<italic>to be thick, solid; to be strong</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. I, 2
<sup>c</sup> bot. (ref. to Gen. I, 6) יֶחֱזַק הרקיע וכ' let the expanse become solidified, let it coagulate, congeal; Gen. R. s. 4; (Yalk. ib. 5 יתחזק, 
<italic>Hithpa.</italic>).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חִיזֵּק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to join, repair, tighten, strengthen</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 94
<sup>a</sup> (expl. חזקיה) שחי' את ישראל וכ' (Ms. M. שהחזיק, 
<italic>Hif.</italic>) he joined Israel to their Father &c. Ib. שחִזְּקוֹ יה the Lord strengthened him. Pes. 45
<sup>a</sup> שעשוי לחַזֵּק Ms. M. where the dough in the cracks is put in for repairing the trough. Sabb. 146
<sup>b</sup> (העשוי) לחַ' when the hole was filled up for making the vessel sound, opp. לשמר to prevent evaporation; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְחוּזָּק, 
<plural-form>pl. מְחוּזָּקִים</plural-form>. Sifré Num. 1 אין מְחַזְּקִים אלא המח' (ed. תמוחז') only the strong-minded it is worth while to strengthen (encourage).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶחֱזִיק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<sup>a</sup>, a. e. בואו ונַחֲזִיק וכ' let us be thankful to the fraudulent poor &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to hold, contain</italic>.</definition>

<pgbrk id="pg445" />אפי' שתין … לא מ' it would not have room even for sixty myriads of reeds. Par. VII, 8 בשביל שתַּחֲזִיק וכ' in order that it (the reservoir) might hold more water. Ukts. III, 12 לא מצא … מחזיק וכ' the Lord found no vessel so fit to contain all blessings as peace; Deut. R. s. 5 end; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (with ב) 
<italic>to take a hold of, seize, take possession</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 4
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. כל מצוה שהֶחֱזִיקוּ וכ' whatever Jewish law the Samaritans have adopted &c., v. דִּקְדֵּק. B. Mets. I, 4 וה' בה and took a hold of it. B. Bath. <definition> (v.

<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. ה' כפרן (in such a case) he is considered a confirmed liar.—Y. Kidd. l. c. bot. הוּחְזְקוּ if they were generally assumed (to be husband and wife); a. fr.—Ḥag. 19

<entry id="H00556">
<head-word>חֲזָקָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (חָזַק) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>taking hold</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>c</sup> top (ref. to II Sam. I, 11) אין ח' וכ' taking hold (of a garment to rend it in mourning) means no less than a hand-breadth of it.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (law) 
<italic>taking posssession, posession, usucaption; claim based on undisturbed possession</italic> during a legally fixed period.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. III, 1 חֶזְקַת הבתים וכ' the legal period of undisturbed possession (in order to give a title) is for houses … three years. Ib. 29
<sup>b</sup> (in Chald. diction) אכלית שני ח' I had the undisturbed usufruct for the period prescribed by law. Ib. 36
<sup>a</sup> עבדים יש להם ח' does the law of possession apply to slaves?—Ib. אין להם ח' לאלתר וכ' present possession gives no title (as is the case with inanimate movable chattel), but a possession of three years does. Ib. III, 2 שלש ארצות לח' there are in Palestine three districts with different usages of possession. Ib. 3 כל ח' שאין וכ' possession without a plea (of purchase or any other mode of legal acquisition) gives no title; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>presumption, presumptive continuance of an actual condition until evidence of a change is produced; legal status</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 9
<sup>a</sup> בהמה בחייה בחֶזְקַת איסור וכ' the anima
<italic>l</italic> when alive, has the status of a forbidden object (v. אֵבֶר), 
<pgbrk id="pg446" />until you ascertain by what means it has been ritually slaughtered; when it is slaughtered הרי היא בח' היתר וכ' it has the status of a permitted object, until you find out how it became forbidden. Gitt. III, 3 בחזקת שהוא קיים under the presumption that her husband (though sick or old when the messenger was deputed) is alive. Keth. 75
<sup>b</sup> ח' דגופא a presumption as regards physical condition, ח' דממונא the fact of possession against which the claimant has to produce satisfactory evidence. Ib. ח' אין אדם שותה וכ' the presumption is that no man drinks out of a cup without examining (that none will marry without having ascertained the woman’s physical condition). Yeb. 31
<sup>b</sup> top חזקת בר שטיא the legal status of an insane person’s property; a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲזָקוֹת</plural-form>. Kidd. 80
<sup>a</sup> סוקלין … מלקין על הח' we execute punishment on the basis of actual facts (though not provable by legal evidence, e.g. man and wife and children living together and treating each other as such, are legally considered as being one family), v. חָזַק 
<italic>Hof</italic>.—Y. Ḥall. IV, 60
<sup>a</sup> bot. לח' with reference to the local usages of usucaption (Gitt. III, 2, v. supra); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>חָזַר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to go around</italic> (searching).</definition>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to turn around, return; to retract, repent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. חֲזוֹר בך come back (repent)! Eduy. V, 6 חזור בך withdraw thy opposition.—Dem. IV, 1 חָזְרָה למקומה came back to its place (was mixed up again). Maas. Sh. I, 5 יֶחְזְרוּ דמים וכ' the money shall return to its former condition, i.e. the sale is annulled, and the money has again its sacred character. Ker. 8
<sup>a</sup> נַחֲזוֹר על הראשונות let us go back to what was said first. Sabb. 118
<sup>b</sup>; Arakh. 15
<sup>b</sup> מימי … וחָזַרְתִּי לאחורי I never said a word (about a fellowman) on which I went back (when confronted with him). Kidd. 59
<sup>a</sup> וחָזְרָה בה and she reconsiders (her consent to be married); חוֹזֶרֶת she may do so; Gitt. 32
<sup>b</sup>. Ib. חוזר ומגרש בו dare he use the same letter of divorce again (after he has revoked it)? Ter. IV, 3 ח' והוסיף then again he added. Gitt. IV, 5 חָזְרוּ לומר then again they said (added); a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to go around from one to the other</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> צריכה לְחַזֵּר על וכ' she must apply to all the brothers successively; (ib. 26
<sup>b</sup>; 51
<sup>b</sup> לַחֲזוֹר). Y. Taan. IV, 68
<sup>a</sup> bot. חִיזַּרְנוּ על כל וכ' we searched the whole Bible; Y. Ab. Zar. I, beg. 39
<sup>a</sup> חי' בכל וכ'; (Sifré Deut. s. 1 חָזַרְנוּ). Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16
<sup>c</sup> top, v. דיאתימון. Kidd. 2
<sup>b</sup> לחַזֵּר על אשה to go around in search of a wife (to woo). Ib. מי חוֹזֵר על מי (Kal) which of them goes around &c.?; Nidd. 31
<sup>b</sup> מי מְחַזֵּר וכ'.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶחֱזִיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to restore, give back</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 27
<sup>b</sup> המַחֲזִיר שלים לרבו he who returns the plain salutation (
<italic>shalom</italic>) of his teacher (without adding, ‘My teacher’). Ib. 32
<sup>b</sup> לא ה' לו שלום did not answer his greeting. B. Mets. 7
<sup>b</sup> יַחֲזִיר לאשה he must restore (the lost document) to the wife. Keth. 73
<sup>b</sup> והֶחֱזִירָהּ and re-married her; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to revoke; to reconsider, to grant a new trial.</italic></definition>

IV, 1 דיני נפשות מַחֲזִירִין וכ' in capital cases verdicts may be reconsidered in favor of the defendant. Ib. VI, 1 מחזירין the convict is brought back for a new trial; a. fr.—[Ib. 33
<sup>b</sup> חוזר, אין מחזירין Ms. F. (ed. חוזרין).]—Eduy. V, 7 החזרת בך, Mish. ed. חָזַרְתָּ, v. supra.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make one read over, to cause correction</italic>.</definition>

<sup>d</sup> מחזירין אותו we order him to read it over again correctly. Ber. 29
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="H00607">
<head-word>חָטַט</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to dig, cut out</italic> (of the sucket), 
<italic>hollow out.</italic></definition>
<notes> Mikv. IV, 3 החוֹטֵט בצינור וכ' if one makes a cavity in a water pipe for the deposit of pebbles. Gen. R. s. 34 היה חוטט את וכ' the embryo would cut its way through &c. Kidd. 24
<sup>b</sup> וחֲטָטָהּ and he (the master) cut it (the eye) out.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to rake, clean a well</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. I, 2 וחוֹטְטִין אותן and you may clean the wells. Ib. 5
<sup>a</sup> ח' … ואין חופרין וכ' you may clean …, but not dig (deepen) &c. [Ib. ולא חוטטין לתוכן you must not rake pebbles into them; v., however vers. Ms. M., Rabb. D. S. a. l.]—Y. ib. 80
<sup>b</sup> bot. חוטטין אותן גרפין לון וכ' (not חוטטן) 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>ot’tin</italic> means ‘they rake them’, as we read (Mikv. l. c.).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to take sheaves out with a rake</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Succ. I, 8 החוטט בגדיש וכ' if one takes sheaves out of a stack, so as to form a shed (Succah). Ib. 15
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חִטֵּט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to rake</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. III, beg. 5
<sup>c</sup> צריך לחַטֵּט ביד וכ' he must rake (coals and ashes out of the oven) with a handle, which proves that he must clean thoroughly.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make holes, to pick</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Mikv. VII (VIII), 2 אוצין צריך לחטט Var. (ed. Zuck. לחַטְחֵט) if the holes in the baskets are filled up with grapes &c., one must clean them by picking. B. Kam. 18
<sup>a</sup> תרנגולין שהיו מְחַטְּטִין וכ' chickens that picked on the rope of a bucket. Tosef. B. Mets. VIII, 30 שמְחַטְּטִין את וכ' (Var. שמְחַטְחֲטִין) for they pick holes in the walls.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (with אחר) 
<italic>to dig after, to trace with the knife</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 74
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. Ib. VII, 4.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to trim</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 90
<sup>a</sup>; Men. 107
<sup>a</sup>, v. מָחַט.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pilp.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חִטְחֵט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Y. Orl. III, 63
<sup>a</sup> מצוי לחַטְחֵט אחריו it is likely that they dig after it (to take it out of the ground); a. e. (v. supra).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֶחֱטַט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be dug out, picked out</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 24
<sup>b</sup> נֶחְטְטָה עינה if the bird’s eye was picked out; Zeb. VII, 5 (68
<sup>b</sup>) Ar. (ed. נסמית).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְחַטֵּט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be exhumed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 63
<sup>b</sup> מתים מִתְחַטְּטִין the dead are exhumed (by the Guebres).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Polel.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חוט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>), 
<italic>part.</italic> מְחוֹטֵט (v. 
<xref rid="M00849">מַחַט</xref>) 
<italic>stinging</italic> (the eye), 
<italic>dazzling</italic>, v. infra.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpol.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְחוֹטֵט</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be cut</italic> (of jewels), 
<italic>to be polished, glisten</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 12
<sup>a</sup> (play on בה̇ט̇, Esth. I, 6) אב̇נים שמִתְח̇וֹטְֹטֹות על בעליהן וי"א אב̇נים המְח̇וֹטְֹטוֹת לעינים במקומן Ms. F. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5) stones which glisten on those who wear them, and some say, Stones which dazzle the eyes in the place where they are found.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to stroll idly, saunter</italic> (v. Fl. to Levy Targ. Dict. I, 424
<sup>2</sup>),] 
<italic>to live in luxury, to be like a nobleman, to be well-dressed, clean</italic> &c. (cmp. פנק, פרנק).</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חִטֵּא, חִטָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to make look well, polish, dress, cleanse, prepare</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 27
<sup>a</sup> (play on וש̇ח̇ט̇, Lev. I, 5) ממקום שש̇ח̇ חַטֵֹּהוּ from the place where the animal bends (its head, the front of the neck), cleanse it (let its blood run out). Ib. ממאי דהאי חטהו לישנא דדכויי הוא how can you prove that this 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>attehu</italic> has the meaning of cleansing?—Ib. ממקום שס̇ח̇ ח̇ט̇הו from where it utters sound, cleanse it. [Cant. R. to VII, 2, v. infra.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְחַטֵּא, הִתְחַטָּה, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְח'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to enjoy, to be gratified</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to VII, 2 [read:] כל חִיטּוּיִין … שישראל מִתְחַטִּין וכ' all luxuries and enjoyments which Israel indulge 
<pgbrk id="pg449" />in and enjoy. Men. 66
<sup>b</sup> (play on נ̇ת̇ע̇ל̇ס̇ה̇, Prov. VII, 18) נ̇שא ונת̇ן ונע̇לה ונ̇שמח ונִתְחַטֵּא באהבים let us have a conversation, then let us go up and rejoice and delight ourselves with dalliances; Sifra Vayikra, N’dabah, ch. XIV, Par. 13. Men. l. c. (play on נ̇ע̇ל̇ס̇ה̇ Job XXXIX, 13) נ̇וש̇א עול̇ה ונתח̇טא; Sifra l. c. נושא ועולה ומִתְחַטֵּא he (the bird) raises (his wings) and rises and enjoys himself (differ. interpret. in Rashi).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to show one’s self a nobleman, to be generous, proud</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to VII, 7 שהיה מתחטא על וכ' he was generous towards &c. (ref. to Gen. XIV, 23, Dan. V, 17).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be imperious, to lord it, to ask petulantly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Taan. III, 8 אתה מתח' לפני thou comest petulantly before the Lord כבן שהוא מתח' על וכ' like a son that lords it over his father &c. Cant. R. to V, 6 (explain. חמק, ib.) נתח' וכ' he became petulant, he got angry with me.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<number>—3)</number>

<sense>
<number>—4)</number>

Pes. 44

<entry id="H00716">
<head-word>חיי, </head-word>
<head-word>חָיָה</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to live</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tam. 32
<sup>a</sup> מה … ויִחְיֶה what must man do in order to live (long)?; a. v. fr.—
<italic>Part.</italic> חָי (v. חַי).—Keth. I, 6 לא מפיה אנו חָיִין we do not live on what comes from her lips, i.e. we do not go by her evidence. Y. ib. II, 26
<sup>c</sup> bot. אנו כחיין מפיה we (the court) are again in the condition of dependence on her own evidence. Y. Shebi. II, 34
<sup>a</sup> top שהן חָיִין מִמֵּי וכ' they live (draw nourishment) from the waters of last year; ib. (הוא חָיָיה) הוא חָיָה it draws &c.—Snh. 108
<sup>a</sup> לא חיין ולא נידונין they have no share in the resurrection nor will they be judged; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to heal; to recover, regain health</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 6
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. עד שתִּחְיֶה המכה until the wound is healed up. Ḥull. 7
<sup>b</sup> וחָיָה and did recover; וחָיָת and it (the wound) healed up; a. fr. [Y. Maasr. I, 48
<sup>d</sup> חיתה; Y. Shebi. IV, 35
<sup>b</sup> bot. חייתה, v. חוּת.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִחְיָיה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be recalled to life, to resurrect.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ab. IV, 22 והמתים להֵחָיוֹת and the dead are destined to be revived. Snh. 90
<sup>b</sup> שעתיד להחיות that he (Aaron) will resurrect.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>חִיָּיה, חִיָּה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to keep alive, sustain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tam. 32
<sup>a</sup> יְחַיֶּה את עצמו let him feed himself (his passions, be selfish). Yoma 71
<sup>a</sup> מְחַיֶּה חיים He who sustains the living; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to recall to life, to revive</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. l. c. הקב"ה מְחַיֶּיה מתים the Lord revives the dead. Ib. מה שאני ממית אני מְחַיֶּה what I put to death, I revive again; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶחְיָה, הֶחְיָיה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Ib. 92
<sup>b</sup> מתים שה' יחזקאל the dead whom Ezekiel revived (Ez. XXXVII). Ib. והַחֲיֵיה מתים וכ' and revive the dead in the valley of Dura; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
